cases.assertion: Four-parameter observation posterior precedes the learning transition; first prediction is 0.34.
The first unhinted reliable answer updates once; retries, hints, manual pending grades, ambiguous concepts, and disabled groups record skip reasons.
Three eligible observations unlock an estimate; learner and course scopes stay isolated across reopen.
Concurrent first answers produce one update, and outbox failure rolls back Attempt and estimate writes.
C-group mastery thresholds, cold start, stop rules, and correction priority are preserved.
Session identity is authoritative; manual-pending answers are not labeled incorrect or saved as answer text.
C-group estimates persist across sessions; A/B paths do not read BKT; high mastery issues a real reviewed question.
Text and scanned PDFs, images, Markdown, DOCX, and PPTX preserve page/slide anchors; OCR output requires review.
Python, TypeScript-facing JSON, Runtime event and command contracts remain aligned.
